stage0093b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$メラン$$
「N23-32, E161-22...
　This is Point X, where we were
　once warped to Paradigm City...!」

stage0093b_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Though I've all but lost my power as a god,
　there's still something I can do.」

stage0093b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「I will fight alongside you as well.
　As one who loves this world and humankind.」

stage0093b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Now that's a reliable ally coming to help out.」

stage0093b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So, what's the current date...?」

stage0093b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$フェルト$$
「October 23rd...
　It's been nearly 10 days since the battle
　against $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.」

stage0093b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$オットー$$
「Only one week left until
　the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ announcement...!?」

stage0093b_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ブライト$$
「We lost time in an unexpected place...」

stage0093b_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$...!
　We've made contact with Captain
　Testarossa of $$メリダ島$$!」

stage0093b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「While we were away, it seems
　Neo Zeon's $$アクシズ$$ has begun
　moving toward Earth!」

stage0093b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$ of $$プリベンター$$
　sent word, too...! Supreme Command will
　meet them with Brigadier General $$サイガス$$'s fleet!」

stage0093b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Damn you, $$シャア$$...!
　He struck first, before Supreme Command
　could finish prepping the colony attack!」

stage0093b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$...!
　Shouldn't we head to space
　right away as well...!」

stage0093b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But after all this fighting, each
　of $c's ships has taken heavy damage...」

stage0093b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「At the very least, we need to make
　emergency repairs. Let's head for
　the $$ミスリル$$ base on $$メリダ島$$.」

stage0093b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「One week until the $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　announcement... Does $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　mean to settle things with the Federation...?」

stage0093b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$オットー$$
「The Red Comet learned we were away
　and saw it as a golden opportunity!
　That has to be it!」

stage0093b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ブライト$$
（I can't believe the $$シャア$$ of today
　would resort to such an underhanded
　tactic...）
